description.value: 6d6 poison. A creature that critically fails becomes a vector: at the start of each of its turns it repeats the save against creatures adjacent to it. The vector effect ends when the creature succeeds at one of these saves, or after 1 minute.

cinderfall.incomplete: Bucket 4 — the "vector" re-sources the effect from whichever creature was just infected, not from the caster. Checked for a real `Aura`-based precedent that dynamically reassigns its source to a newly-affected creature: none found — every real `Aura` rule element is fixed to its owning item's actor. No selector exists for this chained-sourcehood shape.
